title: Family, friends, and business use
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G60 as recommendable to family and friends or suitable for family, commuting, and business use, with a few comments about affordability, embarrassment, or uncertain willingness to recommend it.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car is easy to recommend or show off to family and friends and works well across daily, family, and business needs.

negative.summary: The negative review says the car is so expensive that the reviewer believes most friends and family would not consider owning it.

mixed.summary: The mixed review expresses strong personal enthusiasm for the car while noting the reviewer may have annoyed friends by talking about it too much.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention family, household, business, or recommending the car without enough context to tell whether the sentiment is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Several examples use family, friends, or business only as context rather than direct evaluation of the vehicle.
One positive fragment includes friends reacting to an embarrassing appearance issue, so this topic mixes recommendation and social-use comments with an isolated styling concern.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 reviews on this topic.
